text:
Sarah CSM: Heads up — Sandstone asked for a quick weekend bootcamp to onboard their APAC teams before their renewal call on Monday. Renewal looks soft; they want a hands-on primer (2h) + Q&A. Can we patch a host for Sat 09:00–11:00 UTC (which is Sun 17:00–19:00 AEST)?
James Enablement: I can host the primer but might not be available for the Q&A window. Happy to run the first 90m demo + walkthrough.
Maria Ops: @James Enablement — would you be ok with @Ollie Support covering the last 30m Q&A and follow-ups? Ollie can handle infra/accounting questions.
Ollie Support: Yep I can take the back half. Need the runbook + a list of customer environments and API keys (read-only) to repro issues.
Sarah CSM: Perfect. I'll drop the minimal pre-read and guest accounts now. Link: https://redwood.infra/sandstone/pre-read — includes test creds and a short checklist.
Linda Product: Can we include a short 10-min segment on latest latency/cost improvements? Sandstone asked about token pricing and dedicated slots. I can do that at +30m mark.
James Enablement: Love that — agenda draft:```
00:00 - 10m - Welcome + goals (Sarah)
10:00 - 40m - Quick product overview + billing note (Linda)
40:00 - 1:40 - Hands-on demo: API quickstart + common gotchas (James)
1:40 - 2:00 - Q&A + next steps (Ollie)
```
Maria Ops: Sounds good. Logistics: we need a calendar invite, Zoom link, and a recording enabled. Who will create the invite?
Sarah CSM: I'll create the invite and mark it as private. Adding calendar-bot to auto-post reminders.
calendar-bot: Reminder scheduled: Sandstone Bootcamp — Sat 09:00 UTC. 2 reminders: 24h and 1h before.
Ollie Support: Quick ask — can someone confirm the account sample data is on the staging tenant? The pre-read creds look like prod. I don't want to risk touching prod during demo.
Sarah CSM: Good catch. Swapped to staging creds and re-uploaded. New link is the same URL (token rotated).
James Enablement: Can someone add a short troubleshooting cheat-sheet into the invite notes (3 commands/snippets)? I'll paste mine here:```bash
# fetch example convo
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"xlarge","input":"hello"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>'
```
Linda Product: Also add a slide with renewal checklist: usage trends, forecast, and suggested Dedicated offset. Keep it to one slide.
Maria Ops: Who's owning post-session follow-up and the action tracker? I can make a quick shared doc if someone confirms owner.
Sarah CSM: I'll own follow-ups and open the tracker. @Maria Ops please set up the doc and add the actions during the session.
Ollie Support: One more: Sandstone asked if we can provide a short eval suite they can run against their prompts to show quality regression baseline. Any templated test we can share?
James Enablement: We have a 5-check eval harness; I'll attach it to the invite and show how to run it during the demo.
Sarah CSM: Great. Final checklist before I send the invite: host (James), backup host (Ollie), product segment (Linda), pre-read link, staging creds confirmed, calendar+zoom, recording on, follow-up doc (Maria). Everyone ok?
Linda Product: ✅
Ollie Support: ✅
James Enablement: ✅ — small note: if the session runs late, I may drop at +2h10. Ollie can field overflow.
Maria Ops: ✅ doc will be ready; sharing link in thread once done.
Sarah CSM: Sending invite now. If anyone needs to swap, tell me within 2 hours. Thanks all :thumbsup:
calendar-bot: Event created and shared with participants.
Sarah CSM: Invite sent — attendees + Sandstone CSMs included. Putting post-session tasks: 1) upload recording, 2) action tracker, 3) renewal health flag update. I'll mark renewal as 'watch' and escalate to AM if no usage lift in 72h.
James Enablement: Noted — I'll attach the eval harness to the recording and point to the dedicated recommendation template.
Maria Ops: Doc link: https://docs.redwood.com/sandstone/bootcamp-actions (edit perms to team).
Ollie Support: All set on my side. Ready to field Qs and take notes.
Sarah CSM: Thanks team — let's make this a smooth handoff and try to turn this into a renewal win. :rocket:
